Build Mayfly API request

Source: R/mayfly_utils.R
mayfly_request.Rd

Create an httr2 request object for the Mayfly API endpoints. The Mayfly API uses query parameters (not path segments) for filtering. For example: /mayfly/counts?district=metro&year=2025&date=20250601&detector=100

mayfly_request(
  endpoint,
  district = "metro",
  year = NULL,
  date = NULL,
  detector = NULL
)

Arguments

endpoint

character, API endpoint path (e.g., "counts", "occupancy", "speed", "length", "districts", "years", "dates", "detectors")

district

character, MnDOT district code. Default is "metro". Use mayfly_get_districts() to see available districts.

year

character or numeric, year for data query. Optional.

date

character, date in YYYYMMDD format. Optional.

detector

character, detector ID. Optional.

Value

httr2_request object
